'''Barbas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a guard for [[Qazadi]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]], during his visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]] to meet with [[Black Sun sector chief|sector chief]] [[Avrak Villachor]].<ref name="Scoundrels" />
